children: BioLife Solutions agreed to be acquired by Repligen for $11.25 cash and 0.1442 shares of Repligen stock per BioLife share.
Merger agreement: Repligen will acquire all outstanding BioLife common shares for $11.25 cash plus 0.1442 Repligen shares per share.
Transaction structure: Two-step merger will make BioLife a direct, then indirect, wholly owned Repligen subsidiary upon closing.
Regulatory clearing: HSR waiting period expired Sept. 3, 2026; closing still subject to customary conditions and BioLife shareholder approval.
Shareholder vote: Special meeting of BioLife stockholders is scheduled remotely for Oct. 5, 2026 to consider adoption of the merger.
